description: This PHP source file defines the HomePageService class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods to retrieve default paths for various modules (time, leave, admin, pim, recruitment, performance) and the home page path, leveraging user role management via a trait.

classes.name: HomePageService
classes.description: Service class responsible for retrieving default module paths and homepage path based on user roles.

methods.name: getHomePagePath
methods.description: Returns the home page path for the current user role.

methods.name: getTimeModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for the Time module.

methods.name: getLeaveModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for the Leave module.

methods.name: getAdminModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for the Admin module.

methods.name: getPimModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for the PIM (Personal Information Management) module.

methods.name: getRecruitmentModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for the Recruitment module.

methods.name: getPerformanceModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for the Performance module.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve the default page path for a specified module.
